description: Free, no sign-in. Use for general questions about what private landlords in England must do, such as which certificates a let needs, gas safety, electrical checks, deposits, EPC ratings, smoke alarms, rent increases or notices. Searches Lettance's catalogue of rules, each cited to legislation.gov.uk or GOV.UK, and returns matching rule ids with summaries and a lettance.com link. Use get_rule for one rule's full detail and legal basis. Read-only. No match means the catalogue has no such rule, not that no duty exists.

query.description: Keywords, e.g. 'gas safety certificate' or 'deposit protection'

name: search_rules
title: Search landlord rules
